description.value: Cranked Espresso Bar is a specialty coffee bar and cafe situated in Whistler's Rainbow neighbourhood, just north of Whistler Village, serving premium beans from Detour Coffee Roasters alongside fresh baked pastries and healthy meal options. The cafe features a sunny patio with beautiful views and rounds out its menu with local craft beer, BC wines, and seasonal specialty drinks. A 'Hunter Gather Fridge Full' grab-and-go section and online ordering make it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a quick refuel.
